entities.summary: Josef Linda (b. 1792-06-01, Nové Mitrovice) was a journalist or media commentator of the Early Modern period, marked by exploration, reformation, and the rise of nation-states, active in Nové Mitrovice. Known in the fields of poets & playwrights.
